statement: Nvidia's HBM suppliers can meet only 60% to 70% of the requested HBM volume for the Rubin Ultra generation
why: Memory allocation, not GPU logic capacity, is the binding constraint on Nvidia's next-generation accelerator ramp.

impact.mechanism: Suppliers filling only part of the requested HBM order forces Nvidia to cut per-GPU memory content or slip schedules, which caps deliverable accelerator performance and tightens HBM allocation for everyone else.

evidence.source: Seoul Economic Daily (citing The Information / SemiAnalysis reporting)
evidence.excerpt: suppliers said they could only provide 60% to 70% of the requested HBM volume for the new hardware

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying another publication's reporting; no vendor filing or primary confirmation.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 2 -> 3; sources: Seoul Economic Daily (citing The Information / SemiAnalysis reporting)
